title: The scorecard says from when the owner's judgings are counted, so a window that starts before then does not read as complete
prompt:
Read crates/spawn-cli/src/scorecard.rs (where the card is built from the history, and `reach_tokens`: `tokens_from_ms`, the precedent), crates/spawn-cli/src/scorecard/history.rs (objective 061's owner `GateRun`s), web/src/scorecardFormat.ts, web/src/tokenReach.ts (the same kind of note, for tokens) and web/src/scorecard.ts (the gate time cell's parts).

The problem. After 061 went live, the Scorecard's fleet gate time said "owner judgings 1" of 253 runs over 7 days (lead, 2026-11-12 04:00, from lead-mac's screenshot), on a night with about 8 owner pushes. 061 counts an owner judging only when its record carries the gate's wall clock (`gate_ms`), and the integrator has written that field only since the 03:31:50 deploy. rev-b's live check of the log over 7 days found:
- 36 owner landings and 12 refusals before the deploy, none of them with `gate_ms`;
- one judging after it (request 134834, refused at 03:48, 403 s);
- no retained log that could supply the missing times.
The card shows "1" with nothing to say that it counts from 03:48 only, so the owner reads it as complete.

Required behaviour.
(a) `/api/scorecard` carries `owner_runs_from_ms`: the time of the log's earliest owner judging (`source.moved` or `source.push_refused`) that carries `gate_ms`, whatever the window. It is null when none does.
(b) web/src/scorecardFormat.ts exports `ownerRunsNote(since_ms, owner_runs_from_ms)` (it stays loadable with node alone):
- when the window starts before that time, "Owner judgings counted from <format.ts localDateTime> only: earlier ones carry no gate time.";
- when it is null, "Owner judgings not counted yet: none carries a gate time.";
- when the window starts at or after it, null.
(c) The Scorecard page shows the note beside the gate time's owner runs, for the fleet and each mission, and shows nothing once the window starts after that time.

Acceptance: rsi/scenarios/076.sh. Records are written as the integrator writes them: requests through `spawn_control_record`, their outcomes through `spawn_integrator_record`. `spawn serve` answers. Gate mission 1's task 1 is judged once. Then, a second apart:
- an owner landing recorded as before 061, with no `gate_ms`;
- an owner refusal its gate judged (`gate_ms`, mission 1), the first one counted;
- an owner landing its gate judged.
Checks:
- (1) `owner_runs_from_ms` is the refusal's record time, both for the last hour and for a window that starts after every record.
- (2) Under node, the last hour's note reads "Owner judgings counted from <localDateTime of that time> only: earlier ones carry no gate time.". It is null for the later window and for a window that starts exactly at it, and the null case reads "Owner judgings not counted yet: none carries a gate time.".
It fails with 1 on live main 71d0f27e: there is no `owner_runs_from_ms` and no `ownerRunsNote`.

The product reason. The owner reads that card now. A count that silently covers only the last hour of a seven-day window understates the owner's share of gate time and misleads the compute track's decisions. Saying from when the figure counts lets the owner read it correctly until the window fills on its own, on 11-19.

Rules: never edit the protected paths, which the gate rejects: rsi/, scripts/ (scripts/rsi/, scripts/blackbox/, scripts/e2e.sh among them), deploy/, all of web/ except web/src/, web/test/ and web/index.html, rust-toolchain files and .cargo/. The gate also rejects fewer runnable tests than the base, any lint relaxation and any build-time code. The gate builds offline from the cargo caches already on the host. Keep every existing check green (061's included) and add tests of your own: a scorecard test of `owner_runs_from_ms` (a record without `gate_ms` before it not counted, a refusal counted, the time independent of the window, null with none), and web/test tests for (b) and (c).
